artworks.title: "A Girl Reading. Pietro Magni, Sculptor"
artworks.medium: stereoscopic albumen silver prints
artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet (each): 7.6 x 7 cm (3 x 2 3/4 in.)
mount: 8.3 x 17.3 cm (3 1/4 x 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Suzanne Glover Lindsay
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a girl engrossed in reading a book while seated, with one leg extended and almost touching the floor. Her head is slightly tilted downward, and her gaze is fixed on the open pages before her. She is draped in a flowing garment that extends over the sides of her chair. Surrounding the girl, the chair appears intricately crafted, with a woven seat and sturdy legs that support both her and the book she holds. The sculpture is crafted from a light-colored material, likely marble, giving it a smooth, polished appearance that highlights the delicate features of the figure, including her serene facial expression and finely detailed attire. This artwork captures the sense of stillness and focus associated with reading, as the girl remains absorbed in her activity, indifferent to the world around her. This piece is presented in a stereoscopic format.

artworks.title: Vue du Chateau de Saconnex
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper, mounted on album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Phillips Family Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketched from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is shown at the upper third of the image, with remnants of castle towers and walls visible. Closest to the viewer, there is dense foliage, including trees and bushes, alongside the ruins of a stone wall. The sketch captures a historical architectural scene with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. Further in the distance, more ruins and trees are visible, leading into rolling hills fading into the background. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of gray and different pressures of the pencil for contrast and detailed visuals.

artworks.title: L'Anesse Marie-Jeanne
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey standing next to a cottage with several chickens nearby. The drawing features a donkey carrying a pack on its back, positioned in front of a rustic cottage. The scene captures a rural atmosphere. The building is constructed with a stone facade and has a small window. Surrounding the donkey, several chickens are pecking at the ground. In the background, there are a few trees without leaves and clouds sketched in the sky. The detailed line work creates a textured appearance. The signature at the bottom reads "Landseer" with the date "1872".

artworks.title: L'Entrée de Landemere (The Hague)
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on thin laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This etching shows a rural landscape with a winding path stretching into the distance. A man guides a cow with a cart on the path. Bushes, small trees, and rustic buildings are depicted nearby. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black and grey shades. The lines convey movement and life in the landscape.

artworks.title: Cacoletière Assise (Seated Woman and Ass)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly person seated beside a donkey. The person is on the left side, sitting on a bench with hands on their lap. They have a warm smile and expressive facial features, wearing a headscarf, shawl, and a long garment. A donkey stands beside them, facing right, with a cloth or blanket on its back. The background has a textured wall, suggesting an outdoor or rustic setting.

artworks.title: Cacoletière Assise (Seated Woman and Ass)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey resting beside a seated figure. The drawing depicts a donkey saddled with a blanket, standing to the right of a seated figure in a robe. The figure appears to be sitting on a ledge or bench, facing the donkey, which is looking down towards them. The artwork is rendered with fine lines, creating detailed textures on both the figure's clothing and the donkey's fur. The background is minimally detailed, drawing attention to the central subjects. Geometric lines and shapes can be seen drawn over the composition.

artworks.title: L'Ane et la Vielle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey and a figure. The image centrally features a donkey bearing a load. The donkey stands in an open landscape with a figure in the foreground interacting with it. The background contains indistinct structures or silhouettes. Hatching and cross-hatching techniques dominate the shading of this monochrome scene. Swirling lines in the sky overhead suggest cloud formations. The paper is aged.

artworks.title: Cacoletière à la Tour (Woman Riding an Ass near a Tower)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person riding on the back of a donkey. The person is seated and wearing a cloak or hooded garment that covers their head. The surroundings are minimally detailed, with faint outlines of buildings in the background hinting at a rural or village setting.

artworks.title: Croquis de'Enfants (Sketches of Children)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting three figures - an adult and two children. The adult is seated and facing left, wearing a coat and a cap. The children are sitting in front of the adult, facing forward with heads slightly lowered. The figures are minimally detailed with flowing lines suggesting their hair and clothing. In the background are loosely drawn structures resembling buildings near a body of water.

artworks.title: Cochons au Soleil (Pigs in the Sun)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a herd of pigs. The image features several pigs huddled together. The sketch shows the texture of the animals' skin and the contour of their bodies. Light and shade are used effectively to suggest depth and form. There are intersecting lines in the lower section and a symbol in the upper right corner. The drawing captures movement and concentration within the group of animals.

artworks.title: Une Matinèe d'Automne
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on thin laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a figure walking a dog on a path. Tall trees reach beyond the low horizon. The sun glows faintly, suggesting early morning. The brushstrokes are light and sketch-like. The color palette is primarily shades of gray. Foliage and trees on the right add detail, while the distant landscape fades into the horizon.

artworks.title: Les Gardiens du Logis
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette on heavy wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view with a cart and animals. A horse stands beside a cart with two dogs nearby. In the background, another horse is partially visible. The brushstrokes are sketch-like, providing texture. The color palette consists of shades of gray and black. The illustration captures a rustic outdoor scene with animals and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Têtes de Bretons
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, roulette, and soft-ground on antique laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing on a white paper. The central image appears to be an etching with figures of animals and possibly humans. The background is dark, contrasting with the figures.

artworks.title: Le Patre
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features a ground-level perspective of an earthy scene focused on a tall, arched stone structure. Vines and natural growth cover the weathered structure and figures are seen near the entrance. The brushstrokes are loose and textured, creating a rustic effect. The color palette is warm and monochromatic with a reddish-brown hue.

artworks.title: Le Patre
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration featuring a large archway surrounded by leafless trees and a dusky sky. Near the archway, there is a woman, two children, and a dog. Further back to the left, another figure is walking towards the archway. The fine and detailed brushstrokes give the scene a mysterious feel. The color palette is monochrome, consisting of shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: Le Patre
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove  paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a front-facing view of a stone archway and pathway in a dense, textured environment. The arched opening within the ruins leads the eye towards the space beyond. The etching technique is characterized by heavy and intricate brushstrokes, detailing the architecture and leafless trees. In the scene, a woman stands to the left and a seated figure with a dog is closer to the viewer. The color palette is primarily black and muted shades, highlighting contrasts and shadows. Textural details in the lines enhance the etching's realism.

artworks.title: Road to Perdition
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a small plein air scene with a figure on horseback riding across a vibrant landscape. The horizon is low in the image, emphasizing the sky. The scene is created with expressive brushstrokes depicting movement, especially in the waves or foliage under the horse. The color palette is limited to reddish-brown tones, highlighting details and texture while adding warmth. In the distance, a lone tree stands to the right. The composition balances the actions of the horse and the swirling sky.

artworks.title: Un Chemin de Perdition (Road to Perdition)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a lone rider on a galloping horse crossing a landscape. The horizon is low, with a vast sky filled with swirling clouds dominating the scene. The textured brushstrokes create movement in the clouds and the figure. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey for contrast. The sky suggests turbulent weather, with the rider and horse silhouetted against it. A winding path and a tree with barren branches are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Elle venait lentement...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image displays a scene with a warm sepia tone. The perspective is intimate and slightly elevated, capturing two figures near a building. In the foreground, a person in a long coat and a wide-brimmed hat stands facing a seated figure outside a rustic stone building. The horizon is not distinctly visible. The background features trees and the building facade, depicted with fine etching-like detail. The color palette consists of rich shades of burnt sienna or umber. The trees blend into the textured sky in the background.

artworks.title: Thomas Le Hardouaye
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a low point of view of a group of figures against a textured sky. The horizon line is slightly above the mid-section, with two distinct figures standing; one is on a horse creating a silhouette effect. The brushstrokes are detailed yet loose, capturing movement and atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of warm, earthy terracotta. Additional figures are closer to the viewer, potentially lying down. The background features a sky with softly rendered clouds for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Thomas Le Hardouaye
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on horseback with others scattered around. The central image depicts a solitary rider on a horse, silhouetted against a stormy sky, with swirling clouds. Below the horse, there are figures on the ground. Surrounding this central scene on the same sheet are faint sketches, including cloud formations and a faint visage of a person's face. The overall tone is dark and moody, with a focus on light and shadow to convey tension and movement.

artworks.title: Thomas Le Hardouaye
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features figures and a horse in a landscape. The scene is dynamic and depicted in monochrome tones, creating contrast between the figures and the sky. Dramatic cloud formations fill the sky, giving a sense of movement and atmosphere. In the foreground, there are reclining or fallen figures scattered across the ground. On the right, a lone figure sits on a horse against the sky. Intricate detailing and expressive use of lines suggest a narrative or historical context.

artworks.title: La Vision
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features a rectangular shape filled with swirling lines in a warm orange hue. Two vague figures appear near a glowing source within the abstract composition.

artworks.title: L'Ensorcelée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a busy outdoor scene around a large building with a tower to the left. The horizon line is at the top of the building, creating a sense of depth in the sky above. The painting shows detailed brushstrokes, creating a textured depiction of figures and the environment. The color scheme is mainly sepia, giving the artwork a warm, vintage look. The scene is filled with people engaged in various activities, with one person seated near grass and flowers. Trees and additional figures are present in the background, adding layers to the composition. Wispy clouds in the sepia-toned sky create movement and contrast.
